description: This Rust source file defines data structures, enums, and a parsing function for handling scope strings in a JWT authorization context, including associated tests.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Represents an authorization scope with an action and optional path.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Enumeration of possible actions in a scope: Read, Actuate, Provide, Create.

methods.name: parse_whitespace_separated
methods.description: Parses a string of space-separated scope definitions into a vector of Scope objects, using regex for validation.
